mainEntity.name: What customer information is safe to paste into AI while building a sales page?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, but give AI only the information needed for the task and avoid placing unnecessary sensitive customer, payment, health, or account data into prompts. Review the AI provider’s current data controls before using business information.

Context: Run My AI Business emphasizes secure account connections and owner oversight. The exact handling of submitted information depends on the tools and integrations you choose, so privacy settings should be checked directly.

Key factors:
- Type and sensitivity of the information
- Provider retention and training settings
- Team access and account permissions
- Whether anonymization is practical

Practical guidance: Remove names and identifying details where possible, use placeholders, and maintain a simple record of what information enters each tool. Do not paste passwords or payment credentials into prompts.

The business’s educational approach favors deliberate setup over assuming every AI service handles data identically.
acceptedAnswer.description: Share only the information needed for the task, and avoid passwords, payment details, and unnecessary identifying or sensitive customer data. Use placeholders or anonymized examples, review provider data controls, and limit account access before connecting tools.
